agent.reasons: The entity and its 67% owner and control person, Yusuf Zhou, are both located in Vietnam. Vietnam has been on the FATF increased-monitoring list since June 2023, so 6.2 requires escalation to EDD. This assumes Vietnam is still listed on the 2026-10-27 review date; the evidence doesn't confirm that. Two other sections also call for requesting documents. Under 3.3, ownership is incomplete because the owners of Ember Holdings LLC (33%) are unknown, so someone could hold 25% or more through it. Under 3.5, the registry filing dated 2025-06-16 is more than 6 months old. Under 2.1, escalation is the most severe of these outcomes, so it governs.
still_needed: Beneficial owners of Ember Holdings LLC (its 33% share), and ID verification for any owner holding 25% or more indirectly
A registry filing less than 6 months old
Confirmation that Vietnam is on the FATF increased-monitoring list as of 2026-10-27
